Module com.stockle
Package com.stockle.api.service

Class SnapshotService

java.lang.Object
com.stockle.api.service.SnapshotService
public class SnapshotService extends Object
Service for retrieving per-symbol snapshot data from the Alpaca API. snapshot contains the most recent bar and quote information for a symbol. This service gets snapshots for a list of symbols and parses the response into `SnapshotData` objects keyed by symbol.

  • Method Details

    • getSnapshots

      public Map<String,SnapshotData> getSnapshots(List<String> symbols, String feed)
      gets snapshots (latest bar and quote) for the given symbols. Sends a request to the Alpaca snapshots endpoint and extracts per-symbol minute/daily/previous bar and latest quote information. If a bar or quote is not available for a symbol it will be omitted for that symbol.
      Parameters:
      symbols - the list of stock symbols to fetch snapshots for
      feed - the market data feed to use (e.g., "sip" or "iex")
      Returns:
      a map from symbol to `SnapshotData` containing bar and quote information
